Product, pricing and policy administration

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Separate templates from tenant products
  • Version pricing and policy
  • Promote configuration safely

Technical flow

Every hand-off is a control boundary: on failure the flow holds, refers or denies — it never skips ahead.

  1. 01Platform template
  2. 02Tenant subscription
  3. 03Draft derivative
  4. 04Validate + four eyes
  5. 05Environment promotion
  6. 06Effective product version

1. Canonical template

Platform templates define bounded product families and required contracts. A tenant subscription and derivative can narrow or configure allowed behavior but cannot remove regulatory invariants.

2. Versioned economics

Rates, charges, GST, allocation, eligibility, documents and journey controls use effective-dated immutable versions with independent approval.

3. Promotion

Configuration moves through development, test, UAT and production with diff, validation, conformance, rollback and attribution. An unknown field or stale dependency blocks activation.
